Sara (Partnerships): Heads-up — we need a lightweight partner triage lane for the NovaMarket launch. Thinking: single shared channel + clear escalation chain + 15m daily huddle for first 48h. Thoughts?

Priya (Partner Eng): Agree. Channel name? #partner-nova-hotline ? Also we need an oncall liaison list and a pinned checklist.

Liam (Marketplace): :thumbsup: prefer #marketplace-nova-hotline so marketplace folks see it. Suggest a small 'concierge' rotation: Partner Eng -> Marketplace Liaison -> SRE (only for infra).

Mike (SRE): We shouldn't have SRE as first ping unless it's a suspected infra SEV. Proposed flow: partner -> partner-eng -> marketplace-liaison -> oncall (if SEV1/infra). Escalation SLA: 10m ack, 30m triage, 2h mitigation target.

Jordan (Customer Success): Add SI and HW partner contacts to the channel before launch. If partners message outside hours, auto-page the next-day liaison and send an acknowledgement.

Sara (Partnerships): Good call. I'll draft a mini-runbook and pin it. Can folks paste short checklist snippets we can use? Keep it minimal.

Priya (Partner Eng): Use this snippet to pin:

```
1) Acknowledge within 10m with @channel
2) Triage owner: Partner Eng (assign immediate owner)
3) If infra suspected, escalate to SRE oncall with tag "escalate:sre"
4) If billing/product, tag accordingly: "tag:billing" / "tag:product"
5) For >30m blocking issues, jump to a quick :phone: sync
6) Link to runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.com/partner-nova-triage
```

Liam (Marketplace): We should auto-label incoming messages as product/infra/billing to speed routing. @PartnerOpsBot can we auto-tag based on keywords?

PartnerOpsBot: yes — I can apply tags when messages include keywords. Example config: `tags: ["infra","billing","product"]`. I will also post the channel template and pinned checklist on creation.

Mike (SRE): Operational requirement: all SEV1s must also open an incident in #incidents and include the "partner-concierge" tag. SRE will watch that tag and escalate paging as needed.

Sara (Partnerships): Rotation idea: Priya takes day-1 AM, Liam PM, Jordan night coverage. We'll create a shared calendar invite and a short 15m sync at 8am PT/8pm PT for first 48h.

Jordan (Customer Success): I'll send the invites. Also will add SI and HW partner slack handles and a short onboarding note in the channel for them.

Priya (Partner Eng): One more: for hardware partners require an SI contact cc'ed and hardware vendor slack handle tagged with prefix `hw:` so routing is obvious.

Liam (Marketplace): :thumbsup: makes sense.

Sara (Partnerships): If everyone is aligned I'll create #marketplace-nova-hotline now, pin the checklist, and set the rotation. Will post the runbook link and call out SEV vs non-SEV flow.

Priya (Partner Eng): Go for it.

PartnerOpsBot: Channel #marketplace-nova-hotline created. Pinned: triage checklist. Rotation calendar invites sent to: Priya, Liam, Jordan, Mike. Template posted: https://templates.redwood.com/partner-hotline-template

Mike (SRE): Thanks — will monitor the "partner-concierge" tag. If anyone wants a quick runthrough of the SEV thresholds and paging rules I can do a 10m pre-launch call.

Sara (Partnerships): Please do that, Mike. Ok team — let's keep this light but explicit. We'll iterate after the first 24h. :rocket:
